concepts.name: 04-b-minimal
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a single desktop app icon exploration for BookManager.
Input image 1: the currently selected BookManager icon, used as the design reference and variation base. Preserve its brand identity: an unmistakable uppercase B, ivory paper, a small teal accent, deep navy rounded-square tile. Keep the tile proportions, centered front-facing framing, generous transparent margin, and overall high contrast.
Create ONE standalone square icon, no comparison sheet. Render with a genuinely transparent background outside the navy tile, preserving transparency. No labels, words, watermarks, additional symbols or scene. Keep big bold shapes and clear B counters for a 32px toolbar icon. All details should contribute to the B and book/page idea. The artwork should be clean and polished, not a photograph.
Primary request: a MINIMAL GEOMETRIC B variation, meaningfully flatter and more compact than the reference. Redraw the monogram as one thick, nearly flat ivory shape with a straight vertical book spine, two balanced rounded bowls, and two generous clean navy interior counters. Use a small triangular teal page-fold inset in the lower bowl, entirely contained within the B. The upper bowl is subtly smaller than the lower one. Replace the reference's curled 3D ribbon surfaces with crisp, simple near-flat geometry and extremely subtle edge depth. The navy tile is matte and smooth with a nearly imperceptible lighting gradient. The result should be the simplest and strongest silhouette in the family, quiet and beautifully proportioned. No floating objects, no tiny page lines, no perspective.

concepts.name: 05-b-book-spine
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a single desktop app icon exploration for BookManager.
Input image 1: the currently selected BookManager icon, used as the design reference and variation base. Preserve its brand identity: an unmistakable uppercase B, ivory paper, a small teal accent, deep navy rounded-square tile. Keep the tile proportions, centered front-facing framing, generous transparent margin, and overall high contrast.
Create ONE standalone square icon, no comparison sheet. Render with a genuinely transparent background outside the navy tile, preserving transparency. No labels, words, watermarks, additional symbols or scene. Keep big bold shapes and clear B counters for a 32px toolbar icon. All details should contribute to the B and book/page idea. Primary request: a BOOK-SPINE B variation. Redesign the ivory B as a strong vertical bound-book spine joined to two rounded book-page blocks, one above the other, so the overall silhouette reads unmistakably as a capital B. Each right-hand lobe is the curved fore-edge of a thick stylized book; show only TWO broad ivory page layers per lobe separated by one clean recessed shadow. Keep two generous navy inner openings that form the B counters. A restrained teal hardcover edge traces the outside bottom curve of the lower lobe. This should feel more architectural and solid than the reference, with a squarer left spine and softly rounded upper and lower page blocks, restrained sculptural depth and gentle shadows. Not literal separate stacked books, no titles or spine decorations. Keep the front-on B composition and navy rounded-square tile.

concepts.name: 06-b-ribbon
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a single desktop app icon exploration for BookManager.
Input image 1: the currently selected BookManager icon, used as the design reference and variation base. Preserve its brand identity: an unmistakable uppercase B, ivory paper, a small teal accent, deep navy rounded-square tile. Keep the tile proportions, centered front-facing framing, generous transparent margin, and overall high contrast.
Create ONE standalone square icon, no comparison sheet. Render with a genuinely transparent background outside the navy tile, preserving transparency. No labels, words, watermarks, additional symbols or scene. Keep big bold shapes and clear B counters for a 32px toolbar icon. All details should contribute to the B and book/page idea. Primary request: a CONTINUOUS BOOKMARK-RIBBON B variation. Redraw the B as one wide ivory bookmark ribbon folded into a straight left stem and two broad rounded loops. It must remain an upright clearly readable capital B with two large navy counters, not an abstract knot or number 8. Use one or two crisp origami-like planar folds instead of the reference's curled book-page edges. Finish the ribbon in one short teal V-notched bookmark end tucked along the bottom inside the lower lobe, fully contained within the B silhouette. Use elegant restrained dimensionality, smooth matte ivory surfaces and a clean teal folded end. Make this variation visibly more fluid and angular at its fold joints than the original; retain the same navy rounded-square tile and strong balanced silhouette. No additional dangling pieces outside the B and no long shadows.
